de.name: Mosque of Sheikhun El Omary El Mamlouky
de.text: Diese denkmalgeschützte Kultstätte befindet sich in der Nähe der berühmten Sultan-Hassan-Moschee.

de.name: Al-Rifa'i Mosque
de.text: Diese Moschee steht in direkter architektonischer Nachbarschaft zur Sultan-Hassan-Moschee.

hu.name: Mosque of Sheikhun El Omary El Mamlouky
hu.text: Ez a műemlékvédelem alatt álló istentiszteleti hely a híres Szultán Haszán-mecset közelében található.

hu.name: Al-Rifa'i Mosque
hu.text: Ez a mecset közvetlen építészeti szomszédságban áll a Szultán Haszán-mecsettel.

ro.name: Mosque of Sheikhun El Omary El Mamlouky
ro.text: Acest lăcaș de cult de patrimoniu este situat în apropierea faimoasei moschei Sultan Hassan.

ro.name: Al-Rifa'i Mosque
ro.text: Această moschee se află în vecinătate arhitecturală directă cu Moscheea Sultan Hassan.

en.name: Mosque of Sheikhun El Omary El Mamlouky
en.text: This heritage-listed place of worship is located near the famous Sultan Hassan Mosque.

en.name: Al-Rifa'i Mosque
en.text: This mosque stands in direct architectural proximity to the Sultan Hassan Mosque.
